data.detail: Launch client titled Mobile Legends: 5v5 MOBA released on Android 14 July 2016 (developed by Moonton; distributed by Elex Tech in the US); removed from Google Play after the 2017 Riot Games lawsuit and re-released as Mobile Legends: Bang Bang on 9 November 2016 (same day as iOS launch)

MLBB 2.0 announced at Moonton Epicon 2019 conference: Unity engine upgrade from version 4 to version 2017; promised up to 60% faster loading/start-up; reduced lag; improved character modelling; new in-game map Imperial Sanctuary

Project NEXT announced as flagship client overhaul for the 5th anniversary: user interface changes; older-hero 3D model / skill / story / voice-line revamps; new Smart Targeting aiming method; revamped Brawl mode; new login events; Phase 1 went live 22 September 2020
Project NEXT delivered in three phases: Phase 1 2020-09-22; Phase 2 2021-06-15; Phase 3 2021-09-21
Smart Targeting shipped as an official in-game targeting setting after Project NEXT; ONE Esports guide documents where to enable it in settings

Version scheme changed from 1.x to 2.x: mlbbhub patch index shows last 1.x build 1.9.99 followed directly by 2.1.02 (no 1.10.x and no 2.0.x builds listed); first officially-dated 2.x patches: 2.1.40 (2025-12-25); 2.1.88 (2026-06-17); 2.2.16 (2026-09-16)
AI-generated main menu tested on the Advanced Server drew fan outrage and Moonton backtracked (headline cross-check via Google News RSS)
data.source: https://www.esports.gg (MLBB backtracks after fans outrage over AI-generated main menu in advanced server; 2026-07-21; via news.google.com/rss/search)

data.detail: 7th anniversary in-client event from 19 Sep 2023: free Starblazer Johnson anniversary skin via anniversary coins; To The Stars mini-game (28 stages / 4 chapters; ran to 22 Oct); 2022 Birthday Harley skin; anniversary border / emote / recall effects

8th anniversary from 27 Sep 2024: free Marvelous Maestro Akai skin; Carnival Adventure Monopoly board (dice rolls earn Dream Coins exchangeable for the Panda Warrior skin); Friend Skin Clone event (copy skins from friends as Skin Experience cards); Friends Call Back return campaign

10th anniversary: ALL IN celebration campaign launched 2026-09-04 (free skins and rewards incl. a free Collector per media); October 2026 events across 10 countries in Asia / Europe / Latin America (community gatherings; cosplay; live performances; interactive installations); S42 ranked season hands out avatar border Starward Decade (official 2.2.16 notes)

data.detail: Global mobile title with regional server clusters; available on Android; iOS and HarmonyOS; player base concentrated in East and Southeast Asia

Regional version difference - India: banned 29 June 2020 alongside other Chinese-linked apps; returned on Android 24 April 2024 rebranded as Moba Legends: 5v5! under publisher Vizta Games; players circumvented the ban via VPNs in the interim

Regional publishing difference - US: brief unenforced removal risk under the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act due to ByteDance ownership; association severed in 2026 when Moonton was acquired by Savvy Games Group

Advanced Server is the public test realm: every patch first ships there as separate Advanced Server patch notes before the Official Server (e.g. 1.4.94 Advanced Server notes dated 2020-07-09); unreleased heroes are granted free access there during the test window (1.3.60 note); media preview upcoming heroes/revamps from it

Advanced Server access is documented by mainstream guides (how to download and play on the Mobile Legends Advanced Server); media also calls it Advance/beta server; the name Experimental Server is NOT used by MLBB
data.source: https://www.esports.gg (How to download and play on the Mobile Legends Advanced Server?; 2026-05-04; via news.google.com/rss/search)

data.detail: Sourced regional feature differences: Star Wars 2021 skins region-locked to 12 SEA markets + Japan; First Order Jet Trooper 2022 restricted to specific regions; SpongeBob 2025 worldwide with Russia excluded

MPL ID S9 playoffs decider EVOS Legends vs Alter Ego game 5: Alter Ego carry Rafly Pai Alvareza Sudrajat froze / disconnected at the ~20-minute mark during a decisive team fight; 4-minute technical pause; game resumed; Alter Ego lost the series 2-3; Moonton publicly announced an investigation of the lag incident

MPL PH S11 playoffs: Diggie banned from tournament use until May 16 due to a visual bug in passive Young Again combined with basic-attack lock settings that revealed enemy hero positions outside vision range (virtual map hack); league cited integrity; Blacklist International captain OhMyV33nus publicly criticized the auto-ban

Franco made unplayable (disabled until further notice) on the official server at the start of patch 1.6.42 right after his major skill revamp; community videos showed Iron Hook fired behind the wall freezing the purple buff monster in place so it could not move or reset

Legend skin trail-effects issue compensation: all players received free Magic Wheel Potions and Diamonds; rollout paired with the revamped Magic Wheel ahead of the Project Reforge update (January 2026)
data.source: https://www.gamingonphone.com + EGW News (2025-12-19 headlines; via news.google.com/rss/search)

data.detail: Player guild system is named Squads; patch 1.4.52 (Advanced Server) added the Squads Nearby feature to search for and join Squads of players nearby
Official mode names verified in 2.2.16 notes: VS A.I. and Custom (unlock condition adjusted to reaching Elite rank); Magic Chess (Lv.12); 1 VS 1 (Lv.25)
Multiplayer Training Camp added under Mode > VS A.I. & Custom (official patch note)

Post-match Highlights added in 2.1.88: cloud-generated highlight videos for outstanding performances in Classic and Ranked; Use Template / Without Template options with built-in music and cinematic effects; view or share via Live > My Videos > Match Replays
Profile privacy: option to hide match history from other players (settings how-to)

Credit Score runs 0-100: AFK / Negative Attitude / Intentional Feeding actions deduct 5 points; repeat offences deduct 8-10 points; recovery +1 point from first login each day when below 100 and +1 point per completed match regardless of result
data.source: https://mobile-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Credit_Score (verified via search snippets; consistent with T1-i capture)

data.detail: Third-party guide claims Ranked Mode requires a 90+ Credit Score and free Battle Points reduced ~29% at a score of 80; official thresholds not verified

Enforcement transparency: during the early-2020 map-hack wave Moonton publicly published punishments on its social media accounts; revealing the account IDs of banned players (report -> punishment pipeline)

King of Fighters wave 1 (SNK; March 2019): Chou as Iori Yagami; Karina as Leona Heidern; Guinevere as Athena Asamiya; obtained through a bingo-mechanic event; KOF skins introduced unique ability effects; sound effects and Japanese voice-overs (first skin line with full effect sets outside Legend skins)
King of Fighters wave 2: Aurora as Kula Diamond; Gusion as K'; Dyrroth as Orochi Chris (same bingo-style event)
King of Fighters wave 3: Valir as Kyo Kusanagi; Masha as Mai Shiranui; Paquito as Terry Bogard

Star Wars: Master Yoda for Cyclops and Darth Vader for Argus released July 2021 (teaser poster on Star Wars Day 2021-05-05); time-limited purchase region-locked to Indonesia / Malaysia / Thailand / Philippines / Singapore / Vietnam / Myanmar / Cambodia / Brunei / Laos / East Timor / Japan
Star Wars phase 2: Obi-Wan Kenobi epic skin for Alucard (same regional restriction)
Star Wars phase 3: First Order Jet Trooper for Kimmy (region-restricted); the collaboration returned September 2024 with the same skins re-released

Transformers phase 1 (14 Aug - 11 Nov 2021): Optimus Prime for Johnson; Megatron for Granger; Bumblebee for X.Borg; players collected Transformers parts to obtain a random skin; Wikipedia describes the 2021 event as four phases with lottery and exchange mechanics (ONE Esports presents it as one phase window - see notes CONFLICT)
Transformers phase 2 (24 May - 7 Jul 2022): Starscream for Aldous; Grimlock for Roger; Soundwave & Ravage for Popol and Kupa; bingo event format like King of Fighters

Sanrio characters: Hello Kitty for Angela (skin Heartstring); Pompompurin for Chang'e (Moon Artist); Cinnamoroll for Floryn (Fluffy Dream); Badtz-Maru for Claude (Bad Bro); event re-ran in 2025 and 2026

Kung Fu Panda: General Kai for Thamuz; Akai as Po (ONE Esports names the skin Kung Fu Panda Akai; Wikipedia says Po Ping - see notes CONFLICT); Lord Shen for Ling; jade-ornament draw event with 800 jade ornaments per skin; first 10x draw auto-granted General Kai Thamuz per Advanced Server dry run; extra rewards incl. recall / kill notification / spawn / emotes and exclusive custom actions; no re-run due to failed negotiations with rights holders

Saint Seiya (Shueisha; 24 Oct - 23 Nov 2022): Bronze + Gold pairs - Badang Pegasus Seiya / Sagittarius Seiya; Chou Dragon Shiryu / Libra Shiryu; Valir Phoenix Ikki / Leo Ikki; draw event with Badge of Victory exchange (800 badges per Gold Saint skin); Pegasus Seiya guaranteed within the first 10 draws; Dragon Shiryu and Phoenix Ikki priced 1288 diamonds in shop from 27 Oct and 3 Nov; two recharge phases from 29 Oct; rerun July 2025 with revamped skin effects

Jujutsu Kaisen: Satoru Gojo for Xavier; Nobara Kugisaki for Melissa; Megumi Fushiguro for Julian; Yuji Itadori for Yin; return event June 2024 with updated visual effects (Sukuna) on Yin ultimate when using the Itadori skin
Attack on Titan (announced January 2024; live 2 February 2024): Eren Yeager for Yin; Mikasa Ackerman for Fanny; Levi Ackerman for Martis

Hunter x Hunter (28-day event): Gon Freecss for Dyrroth; Hisoka Morow for Cecilion; Kurapika for Julian; Killua Zoldyck for Harith; Hunter Coins earned from draws and exchanged in the event shop at 1200 coins per skin

Naruto Shippuden phase 1 (announced 2025-03-24): Naruto Uzumaki for Lukas; Sasuke Uchiha for Suyou; Sakura Haruno for Kalea; Kakashi Hatake for Hayabusa (Team 7 via draw event); Gaara for Vale (free via event requirements); introduced two new item categories - Common Sacred Statue (Gamakichi) and Loading Effect; themed chat bubbles; sacred statues; battle emotes; free iPhone 16 Pro giveaway
Naruto Shippuden phase 2: Itachi Uchiha for Julian; Minato Namikaze for Gusion; return of all phase-1 skins; final arc announced by Moonton 2026-04-27 with final phase running into May 2026
